studies.evidence_quote: Participants were randomly assigned (1:1:1) to receive once-weekly, subcutaneous 10-mg (n = 70) or 15-mg (n = 71) tirzepatide or placebo (n = 69), plus a lifestyle intervention, for 52 weeks. Co-primary end points were the percent change in body weight from baseline and weight reduction of at least 5% at week 52. Of 210 randomized participants...201 (95.7%) completed the trial.

studies.description: This single phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled multicenter trial tested whether once-weekly tirzepatide 10 mg or 15 mg, alongside lifestyle intervention, produced greater weight loss than placebo in Chinese adults with obesity or overweight without diabetes.

studies.evidence_quote: This 72-week, multicentre, randomised, double-blind, parallel group trial... Participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1:1 ratio to receive either tirzepatide 10 mg or 15 mg, or matching placebo... Of 1514 participants assessed for eligibility, 938 participants were enrolled, randomly assigned, and received at least one dose of tirzepatide 10 mg (N=312), tirzepatide 15 mg (N=311), or placebo (N=315).

studies.description: SURMOUNT-2 was one phase 3 randomized trial testing whether 72 weeks of once-weekly tirzepatide 10 mg or 15 mg, compared with placebo, reduced body weight in adults with overweight or obesity and type 2 diabetes. The two tirzepatide doses are parallel treatment arms within the same dataset, not separate studies.

primary_outcomes: Percent change in body weight from randomization to week 72
Proportion of participants achieving at least 5% body-weight reduction from randomization to week 72
studies.evidence_quote: This 84-week, multicenter, randomized, parallel-arm, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial was conducted at 62 medical research centers... Of the 806 participants enrolled, 579 (71.8%) who achieved ≥5% weight reduction at the end of the lead-in period... were randomized to either tirzepatide maximum tolerated dose (MTD, n = 287) or placebo (n = 292). Coprimary endpoints were per cent change in body weight and the proportion of study participants who achieved ≥5% weight reduction from randomization to week 72.

studies.description: A single phase 3 trial enrolled 806 participants into a common 12-week intensive-lifestyle lead-in, then randomized the 579 participants who achieved at least 5% weight loss to tirzepatide or placebo for 72 weeks. It tested whether tirzepatide produced additional weight loss and improved weight-loss maintenance compared with placebo.

studies.evidence_quote: Between April 20, 2021, and June 30, 2023, a total of 1494 patients were screened, and 731 patients were randomly assigned to receive tirzepatide (364 patients) or placebo (367 patients) at 129 centers in nine countries. ... the two primary end points of the trial were designated as a composite of adjudicated death from cardiovascular causes or a worsening heart-failure event, assessed in a time-to-first-event analysis ... and the change at 52 weeks in the KCCQ-CSS.

studies.description: The single SUMMIT international, double-blind randomized trial tested whether weekly tirzepatide, compared with placebo, reduced cardiovascular death or worsening heart-failure events and improved health status in patients with obesity and heart failure with preserved ejection fraction. Participants were followed for at least 52 weeks (median follow-up, 104 weeks).

primary_outcomes: Mean percent change in bodyweight from baseline to week 72
Proportion of participants achieving at least 5% bodyweight reduction at week 72
studies.evidence_quote: SURMOUNT-J was a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group phase 3 trial... Participants were randomly assigned 1:1:1 to receive tirzepatide (10 mg or 15 mg) or placebo... This Article presents data excluding 65 screened and 42 randomly assigned participants due to the exclusion of one study site resulting in 225 randomly assigned participants included in this analysis... At week 72, the least-squares mean percent change from baseline in bodyweight was −17·8%, −22·7%, and −1·7% in the tirzepatide 10-mg, tirzepatide 15-mg, and placebo groups, respectively.

studies.description: A single 72-week phase 3 trial tested whether tirzepatide 10 mg or 15 mg, added to lifestyle modification, reduced bodyweight more than placebo in Japanese adults with obesity disease and without diabetes. Although 267 participants received treatment across 18 sites, the prespecified reported mITT analysis contained 225 participants from 17 sites after one site was excluded for regulatory noncompliance.

A total of 670 participants... were randomized to continue receiving the maximum tolerated dose of tirzepatide (n = 335) or switch to receiving placebo (n = 335).

Although 783 participants entered the lead-in, the comparative randomized analysis included 670 participants.

studies.description: SURMOUNT-1 was one phase 3 multicenter, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial testing three maintenance doses of once-weekly tirzepatide versus placebo in adults with obesity or overweight without diabetes. The paper reports the 72-week primary treatment phase and 4-week safety follow-up from this single randomized sample.
